outputContract: For either an initial assessment or a review, report the complete set of applicable candidate finding IDs. Return only a JSON object with one field, defectIds, containing an array of unique IDs from the candidate list. Use an empty array if none apply. Array order does not matter.

tasks.task: The function must sum strictly positive elements of a non-null int array. The mathematical sum fits in an int. Identify defects in the implementation.

findings.A: The loop attempts to read at index values.length.
findings.B: The condition selects negative elements instead of positive elements.
findings.C: The accumulator starts at one, so it adds an extra unit.

tasks.task: The function must return a new array containing the first min(limit, values.length) elements. The caller supplies a non-null array and a nonnegative limit. Identify defects in the implementation.

findings.A: A limit larger than the input length causes an out-of-bounds read.
findings.B: A zero limit copies one element instead of returning an empty array.
findings.C: The returned array shares its storage with the input array.

tasks.task: In PostgreSQL, accounts has a unique non-null id and three non-null Boolean columns. Return each account ID if it is active or an admin, and is not suspended. Identify defects in the query.

findings.A: An active suspended account can appear because AND binds more tightly than OR.
findings.B: An inactive admin who is not suspended is always excluded.
findings.C: An account that is both active and an admin appears twice.

tasks.task: In PostgreSQL, categories.id and products.id are primary keys and products.category_id references categories.id. Return one row per category with the number of matching products, including categories with zero products. Identify defects in the query.
tasks.code:
SELECT c.id, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id;

findings.A: Categories with no products are omitted.
findings.B: A category with no products receives a count of one.
findings.C: A category with several products produces several result rows.
